rationale: Round-3 minimal confirm of d59622b3, codebase-pin lens. (1) THE TWO NEW RED-ON-REVERT TESTS RUN AND PROVEN RED-ON-REVERT: TestFetchBeadByID_AC11RenderingLeg and TestGateReadiness_RenderingLegControlBytesEscaped both PASS as committed; I then reverted BOTH wrapper call sites to bare %w of err (FetchBeadByID in beads.go, GateReadiness in ready_gate.go) and both tests FAILED exactly as designed, closing the round-2 gap where chain tests alone stayed green on a dropped wrapper. Worktree restored and verified byte-identical afterward (git diff HEAD --quiet clean). The FetchBeadByID test drives the real PATH-shimmed bead.RunBD chain; the GateReadiness test's evaluateReadinessFn seam-swap is appropriate for that site since the wrapper AT the GateReadiness wrap is what's under test. The commit's armed-not-hypothetical claim checks out: MergeMetadata/DeleteMetadataKeys both read via GetMetadata -> tracedOutput first, so a read failure carries wrapBDError-folded bd stderr. (3) SCOPE/OVERLAP: exactly three files, all inside internal/next (beads_test.go, ready_gate.go, ready_gate_test.go); cmd/mindspec/next.go, internal/next/guard.go, and internal/approve/spec.go remain untouched — parallel-track boundary held, and the round-1 accepted-risk note for next.go's own two legs stands unchanged. Suites: fresh -short -count=1 full runs green (internal/next 10.8s, internal/bead 5.6s); go build ./... clean. Standing APPROVE confirmed.
